mapper.insert: insert into sys_hr_sign_event_outbox ( action_id, event_version, payload_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_http_status, last_error, remote_task_id, version, sent_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{actionId}, #{eventVersion}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{lastHttpStatus}, #{lastError}, #{remoteTaskId}, #{version}, #{sentTime}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_hr_sign_event_outbox set status = 'SENT', next_retry_time = null, last_http_status = #{lastHttpStatus}, last_error = null, remote_task_id = #{remoteTaskId}, sent_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'SENDING' and version = #{version}

update sys_hr_sign_event_outbox set status = 'RETRY', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_http_status = #{lastHttpStatus}, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'SENDING' and version = #{version}
